status: Team-owned template library service foundation verified in isolated PostgreSQL; native UI/transport/recovery and wider feature/Px remain open.

contract.entry: New public invoker RPC taskfold_team_templates(_operation,_body) delegates to one private privileged helper with explicit grants, empty search_path, current-session actor validation and current database membership checks.
contract.permissions: Owners/admins curate; accepted full members browse/get. Team guests and outsiders get no team-wide library access. Both existing team and separate library gates must be enabled. New library gate defaults false. Archived teams can read but cannot curate; deleted teams cannot read.
contract.storage: Private RLS-enabled config/state/identities/definitions/receipts; no direct client table access. Versioned documents are opaque bounded storage, not authority to create/update tasks or projects. Known and future definitions must be validated by clients, and any future run service must validate anew.
contract.limits: Names 1–160 characters/640 UTF-8 bytes without controls or bidi overrides; document normalized JSONB text <=2,000,000 bytes, positive integral version <=9007199254740991; active definitions <=200/team and <=32 MiB/team. Team administration quota retained; deletion remains possible at quota and at maximum item revision.
contract.concurrency: Auth locks precede team locks, current roles rechecked after waiting. Exact per-template revision guards replace/delete; permanent removed identities prevent silent resurrection/reuse. Catalog pages contain <=50 metadata-only rows; continuation requires a matching monotonic library revision, otherwise PT409.
contract.durability: HMAC-bound actor/action/body receipts make retries acknowledge only the original action without overwriting later work or resurrecting deleted content. Receipts expose no definition text. Actor removal redacts creator/receipt actor links, retains team-owned work and reserves request identities.
contract.cleanup: Soft team deletion purges library state, definition content, identity markers and receipts. Transactions roll back identity/content/usage/receipt on failure. Existing task/project/team authority remains separate.

result.name: auth_rls_initplan
result.title: Auth RLS Initialization Plan
result.description: Detects if calls to `current_setting()` and `auth.<function>()` in RLS policies are being unnecessarily re-evaluated for each row
result.detail: Table `public.projects` has a row level security policy `fixture_project_access` that re-evaluates current_setting() or auth.<function>() for each row. This produces suboptimal query performance at scale. Resolve the issue by replacing `auth.<function>()` with `(select auth.<function>())`. See [docs](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security#call-functions-with-select) for more info.

verificationScope: Real repo-owned migrations and JWT/SQL roles in isolated pinned PostgreSQL containers. No HTTP, Core/SDK, native/UI, cloud, release, large-template network transfer or installed acceptance claimed. Fixture constructs large JSON inside SQL to avoid host process argument limits.
diagnostics: Initial test used undefined with a helper whose default expected value is true; metadata omission assertions now use Object.hasOwn explicitly.
A fixture seed query missed a space before FROM after a JSONB cast; corrected before successful acceptance.
The scalar fixture requires a JSON value for SQL NULL; creator-redaction assertion now uses coalesce(to_jsonb(...),null::jsonb).
One update-helper indentation error prevented edits; two already-started fixture runs consequently repeated the known scalar assertion issue. Their failed logs are retained, not claimed green.
Catalog revision continuation and deletion at maximum item revision were added before the final passing service runs.

references.finding: Current breaking-change entries inspected; no change to these isolated SQL contracts required.
Private privileged helper, qualified names, invoker public wrapper and explicit execution grants.

remaining: Typed Core/Backend transport and protocol acceptance

Native Mac/phone/tablet, accessibility/layout and genuine hosted/multi-actor/network acceptance
